Raise `TypeError` if `text` is not a string. Every returned list and dictionary must be newly allocated.

import unittest
import math
from solution import extract_epoch_series


class ExtractEpochSeriesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sections_replacement_sorting_and_malformed_lines(self):
        text = (
            "ignored\n"
            "epoch=2; validation_score=0.2; validation_error=2; learning_score=0.3; learning_error=3\n"
            "epoch=0;validation_error=1;learning_error=4;validation_score=0.5;learning_score=0.6\n"
            "epoch=2;validation_score=0.9;validation_error=9;learning_score=0.8;learning_error=8\n"
            ":: next\n"
            "bad line\n"
            "epoch=-1;validation_score=1;validation_error=1;learning_score=1;learning_error=1\n"
            ":: empty\n"
            "epoch=3;validation_score=1.5;validation_error=0.1;learning_score=1.2;learning_error=0.2\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(extract_epoch_series(text), [
            {
                'epochs': [0, 2],
                'validation_score': [0.5, 0.9],
                'validation_error': [1.0, 9.0],
                'learning_score': [0.6, 0.8],
                'learning_error': [4.0, 8.0],
            },
            {
                'epochs': [3],
                'validation_score': [1.5],
                'validation_error': [0.1],
                'learning_score': [1.2],
                'learning_error': [0.2],
            },
        ])

    def test_extra_missing_duplicate_and_nonfinite_fields_are_ignored(self):
        text = (
            "epoch=0;validation_score=1;validation_error=2;learning_score=3\n"
            "epoch=0;validation_score=1;validation_error=2;learning_score=3;learning_error=4;extra=5\n"
            "epoch=0;epoch=1;validation_score=1;validation_error=2;learning_score=3;learning_error=4\n"
            "epoch=0;validation_score=nan;validation_error=2;learning_score=3;learning_error=4\n"
            "epoch=1.0;validation_score=1;validation_error=2;learning_score=3;learning_error=4\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(extract_epoch_series(text), [])

    def test_empty_and_only_separators(self):
        self.assertEqual(extract_epoch_series(""), [])
        self.assertEqual(extract_epoch_series(" \n :: a\n\n::b\n"), [])

    def test_type_error_and_fresh_allocations(self):
        for value in (None, 3, [], b'x'):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                extract_epoch_series(value)
        text = "epoch=0;validation_score=1;validation_error=2;learning_score=3;learning_error=4"
        first = extract_epoch_series(text)
        second = extract_epoch_series(text)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0])
        for key in first[0]:
            self.assertIsNot(first[0][key], second[0][key])
        first[0]['epochs'].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(second[0]['epochs'], [0])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
